admission.justification: Preserving the fixed priority and complete hover prevents a dominant gate or chat from silently hiding a separately actionable handover.

applicability: The single priority word and full hover of an Operations task row.
conditions: Gate, inbox handover, chat and lifecycle facts retain their separate owners.
Lower-priority facts stay recoverable in the whole-row hover.
exclusions: Deriving a gate or lifecycle event from UI colour or a session state.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/rowState.test.ts: "says the most pressing fact as the one word"; dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/signals.test.tsx (8 tests); dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/admission.test.tsx: "renders ONE task entry per enclosureId: a bound lifecycle annotates the doc row, never duplicates it".

statement: A row says one word, taken by a fixed order of what presses most: an open gate, a hand-over that is overdue or unacknowledged, a chat that needs input, "your turn" or "blocked", a chat at work, then the state; everything else the row knows stands in the hover text of the whole row.
